literal: Duan Rong; Duan Shao
idiomatic: Duan Rong; Duan Shao

literal: Duan Rong, styled Zimao, was a native of Gugang in Wuwei.
idiomatic: Duan Rong, styled Zimao, was a native of Gugang in Wuwei.

literal: His grandfather Xin served the Juqu clan; later he entered Wei and, as a prominent clan, was relocated to the northern frontier, settling in Wuyuan Commandery.
idiomatic: His grandfather Xin served the Juqu clan; later he entered Wei and, as a prominent clan, was relocated to the northern frontier, settling in Wuyuan Commandery.

literal: His father Lian served as military aide of the Anbei headquarters.
idiomatic: His father Lian served as military aide of the Anbei headquarters.

literal: From youth Rong loved calendrical arts and devoted himself to stars and portents.
idiomatic: From youth Duan Rong loved calendrical arts and devoted himself to stars and portents.

literal: At the beginning of Zhenguang, he told people, "The Book of Changes says, 'Observe the heavens to discern changes in the times,' and also says, 'Heaven displays signs, revealing fortune and calamity.' Now observing the dark heavens and examining human affairs, within ten years there will be turmoil.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenguang, he told people, "The Book of Changes says, 'Observe the heavens to discern changes in the times,' and also says, 'Heaven displays signs, revealing fortune and calamity.' Now observing the dark heavens and examining human affairs, within ten years there will be turmoil.

literal: " Someone asked, "Where will it begin — can one avoid it?
idiomatic: " Someone asked, "Where will it begin — can one avoid it?

literal: " Rong said, "The source of strife will begin here; I fear the realm will be swept along in the torrent — there is nowhere to escape.
idiomatic: " Duan Rong said, "The source of strife will begin here; I fear the realm will be swept along in the torrent — there is nowhere to escape.

literal: " Before long, it happened just as he said.
idiomatic: " Before long, it happened just as he said.

literal: When turmoil came, Rong, with his fellow townsmen, took wife and children and hurried south toward Pingcheng.
idiomatic: When turmoil came, Duan Rong, with his fellow townsmen, took wife and children and hurried south toward Pingcheng.

literal: Just then Du Luozhou rebelled; Rong and the Grand Ancestor plotted to kill him, but the matter failed, and together they fled to Erzhu Rong.
idiomatic: Just then Du Luozhou rebelled; Duan Rong and Gao Huan plotted to kill him, but the matter failed, and together they fled to Erzhu Rong.

literal: Later, when the Grand Ancestor raised the righteous banner in Shandong, Rong helped bring the great plan to fruition.
idiomatic: Later, when Gao Huan raised the righteous banner in Shandong, Duan Rong helped bring the great plan to fruition.

literal: He served as right deputy of the mobile office, ambassador to pacify and instruct the northwest circuit, touring the regions to enlighten and persuade; wherever he went, people submitted.
idiomatic: He served as right deputy of the mobile office, ambassador to pacify and instruct the northwest circuit, touring the regions to enlighten and persuade; wherever he went, people submitted.

literal: When the Grand Ancestor marched south to attack Ye, he left Rong to garrison Xindu and concurrently appointed him General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Ding Province.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan marched south to attack Ye, he left Duan Rong to garrison Xindu and concurrently appointed him general who pacifies the north and governor of Ding Province.

literal: At that time the attack on Ye had not yet succeeded; whatever military supplies were needed, Rong transported them without shortfall.
idiomatic: At that time the attack on Ye had not yet succeeded; whatever military supplies were needed, Duan Rong transported them without shortfall.

literal: When the Grand Ancestor entered Luoyang, for merit he was enfeoffed Marquis of Gugang County with a fief of eight hundred households.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan entered Luoyang, for merit Duan Rong was enfeoffed marquis of Gugang County with a fief of eight hundred households.

literal: He was transferred to Governor of Ying Province.
idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Ying Province.

literal: Rong's wife was the empress's elder sister; fearing the Grand Ancestor would draw criticism for favoring private kin, Rong firmly yielded to other generals and in the end never went to the province.
idiomatic: Duan Rong's wife was the empress's elder sister; fearing Gao Huan would draw criticism for favoring private kin, Duan Rong firmly yielded to other generals and in the end never went to the province.

literal: Soon he acted as administrator of Xiang Province; later he became Governor of Ji Province.
idiomatic: Soon he acted as administrator of Xiang Province; later he became governor of Ji Province.

literal: In the third year of Tianping, he was transferred to act as administrator of Tai Province.
idiomatic: In the third year of Tianping, he was transferred to act as administrator of Tai Province.

literal: Rong was mild by nature; everywhere he served he practiced benevolence and forbearance, and officials and common people alike loved him.
idiomatic: Duan Rong was mild by nature; everywhere he served he practiced benevolence and forbearance, and officials and common people alike loved him.

literal: At first, when the Grand Ancestor planned to take the Guanxi region, he secretly consulted Rong, who strongly argued it was not yet feasible.
idiomatic: At first, when Gao Huan planned to take the Guanxi region, he secretly consulted Duan Rong, who strongly argued it was not yet feasible.

literal: When they suffered defeat at Weiqu, the Grand Ancestor regretted it and said, "I did not heed Duan Rong's counsel, and so came to this.
idiomatic: When they suffered defeat at Weiqu, Gao Huan regretted it and said, "I did not heed Duan Rong's counsel, and so came to this.

literal: " In the fourth year he was appointed grand commissioner of Shandong and grand commander; he won the hearts of all greatly.
idiomatic: " In the fourth year he was appointed grand commissioner of Shandong and grand commander; he won the hearts of all greatly.

literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang, he was granted three imperators' protocol.
idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanxiang, he was granted three imperators' protocol.

literal: In the fifth month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year he died, aged sixty-two.

literal: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ji, Cang, and Ying, Governor of Ding Province, Grand Commandant, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; his posthumous title was Zhaojing.
idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ji, Cang, and Ying, governor of Ding Province, grand commandant, and left vice director of the masters of writing; his posthumous title was Zhaojing.

literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was given associated sacrifice in the Grand Ancestor's temple court.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court.

literal: In the second year he was again posthumously granted Grand Marshal, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Prince of Wuwei.
idiomatic: In the second year he was again posthumously granted grand marshal, director of the masters of writing, and prince of Wuwei.

literal: His eldest son Shao succeeded.
idiomatic: His eldest son Shao succeeded.

literal: Shao, styled Xiaoxian, had the childhood name Tiefa.
idiomatic: Shao, styled Xiaoxian, had the childhood name Tiefa.

literal: From youth he was skilled at mounted archery and possessed the talent and strategy of a commander.
idiomatic: From youth he was skilled at mounted archery and possessed the talent and strategy of a commander.

literal: The Grand Ancestor, because he was the nephew of Empress Lou Wuming, fully treasured and loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and regarded him as a trusted confidant.
idiomatic: Gao Huan, because Shao was the nephew of Empress Lou Wuming, fully treasured and loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and regarded him as a trusted confidant.

literal: At the beginning of the righteous enterprise, he commanded trusted bodyguards.
idiomatic: At the beginning of the righteous enterprise, he commanded trusted bodyguards.

literal: In the first year of Zhongxing, he followed the Grand Ancestor in resisting Erzhu Zhao; they fought at Guang'a.
idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongxing, he followed Gao Huan in resisting Erzhu Zhao; they fought at Guang'a.

literal: The Grand Ancestor said to Shao, "They are many and we are few — what is to be done?
idiomatic: Gao Huan said to Shao, "They are many and we are few — what is to be done?

literal: " Shao said, "What is called 'many' is winning the people's willingness to die;
idiomatic: " Shao said, "What is called 'many' is winning the people's willingness to die;

literal: what is called 'strong' is winning the hearts of the realm.
idiomatic: what is called 'strong' is winning the hearts of the realm.

literal: Erzhu is reckless and cunning — what everyone on the road sees: they tear off caps and destroy crowns, uproot foundations and block the source. At the assembly at Mount Mang, what crime did the gentry commit? Yet they also killed their lord and set up another — within no more than ten days and a month the realm yearns for disorder; nine of ten households.
idiomatic: Erzhu is reckless and cunning — what everyone on the road sees: they tear off caps and destroy crowns, uproot foundations and block the source. At the assembly at Mount Mang, what crime did the gentry commit? Yet they also killed their lord and set up another — within no more than ten days and a month the realm yearns for disorder; nine of ten households.

literal: Your Highness personally displays virtue and righteousness, removing evil at the ruler's side — where could you go without prevailing!
idiomatic: Your Highness personally displays virtue and righteousness, removing evil at the ruler's side — where could you go without prevailing!

literal: " The Grand Ancestor said, "Although I take righteousness against rebellion and go forth with a mandate to punish crime, we are weak amid the strong — I fear we lack Heaven's mandate. Have you not heard of this?
idiomatic: " Gao Huan said, "Although I take righteousness against rebellion and go forth with a mandate to punish crime, we are weak amid the strong — I fear we lack Heaven's mandate. Have you not heard of this?

literal: " He answered, "Shao has heard that the small can overcome the large, and the way that is small may yet overcome one that is great and excessive; August Heaven is not partial — only virtue receives its aid. Erzhu outwardly harms the realm and inwardly loses good men; the wise will not plan for him, the brave will not fight for him. The unworthy lose their offices; the worthy take them — what doubt remains?
idiomatic: " He answered, "Shao has heard that the small can overcome the large, and the way that is small may yet overcome one that is great and excessive; August Heaven is not partial — only virtue receives its aid. Erzhu outwardly harms the realm and inwardly loses good men; the wise will not plan for him, the brave will not fight for him. The unworthy lose their offices; the worthy take them — what doubt remains?

literal: " They then fought Zhao; Zhao's army collapsed.
idiomatic: " They then fought Zhao; Zhao's army collapsed.

literal: They attacked Liu Yan at Ye.
idiomatic: They attacked Liu Yan at Ye.

literal: At the Battle of Hanling, Shao commanded and led his division as vanguard, breaking through the enemy lines.
idiomatic: At the Battle of Hanling, Shao commanded and led his division as vanguard, breaking through the enemy lines.

literal: Soon he followed the Grand Ancestor out of Jinyang, pursued Erzhu Zhao to Chihong Ridge, and pacified him.
idiomatic: Soon he followed Gao Huan out of Jinyang, pursued Erzhu Zhao to Chihong Ridge, and pacified him.

literal: For military merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xialuo County.
idiomatic: For military merit he was enfeoffed baron of Xialuo County.

literal: He also followed in the surprise capture of Xia Province, taking Hulu Mi'etuo prisoner; he was promoted to Dragon-Courser General and Remonstrating Grandee, rising in succession to General of Martial Guards.
idiomatic: He also followed in the surprise capture of Xia Province, taking Hulu Mi'etuo prisoner; he was promoted to dragon-courser general and remonstrating grandee, rising in succession to general of martial guards.

literal: Later, by grace his father Rong was given the title Marquis of Gugang County; Shao petitioned to yield his barony of Xialuo County to his younger half-brother Ning'an.
idiomatic: Later, by grace his father Duan Rong was given the title marquis of Gugang County; Shao petitioned to yield his barony of Xialuo County to his younger half-brother Ning'an.

literal: In the fourth year of Xinghe, he followed the Grand Ancestor in opposing the Zhou Emperor Wen at Mount Mang.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xinghe, he followed Gao Huan in opposing Yuwen Tai at Mount Mang.

literal: The Grand Ancestor was personally among the ranks; recognized by the Western Wei general Heba Sheng, Sheng led crack troops to press close.
idiomatic: Gao Huan was personally among the ranks; recognized by the Western Wei general Heba Sheng, Sheng led crack troops to press close.

literal: Shao galloped up from the side, drew his bow and shot back; one arrow killed Sheng's lead rider. The pursuers were awed and dared not press forward.
idiomatic: Shao galloped up from the side, drew his bow and shot back; one arrow killed Sheng's lead rider. The pursuers were awed and dared not press forward.

literal: When the Western army withdrew, he was granted horses and gold and his rank was advanced to duke.
idiomatic: When the Western army withdrew, he was granted horses and gold and his rank was advanced to duke.

literal: In the fourth year of Wuding, he followed the campaign against Yubi.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of Wuding, he followed the campaign against Yubi.

literal: At that time the Grand Ancestor was unwell; the siege had not succeeded, and he summoned the generals to discuss together whether to advance or halt.
idiomatic: At that time Gao Huan was unwell; the siege had not succeeded, and he summoned the generals to discuss together whether to advance or halt.

literal: He said to Grand Marshal Hulu Jin, Minister of Education Han Gui, Left Guard General Liu Feng, and others, "Whenever I discuss warfare with Duan Xiaoxian, he shows remarkable strategic brilliance. Had I used his plans all along, I might have been spared today's toil.
idiomatic: He said to grand marshal Hulu Jin, minister of education Han Gui, left guard general Liu Feng, and others, "Whenever I discuss warfare with Duan Xiaoxian, he shows remarkable strategic brilliance. Had I used his plans all along, I might have been spared today's toil.

literal: I fear my illness is grave and dread some unforeseen turn; I wish to entrust Xiaoxian with affairs below Ye — what do you think?
idiomatic: I fear my illness is grave and dread some unforeseen turn; I wish to entrust Xiaoxian with affairs below Ye — what do you think?

literal: " Jin and the others said, "No one knows a subject better than the lord — truly none surpasses Xiaoxian.
idiomatic: " Jin and the others said, "No one knows a subject better than the lord — truly none surpasses Xiaoxian.

literal: " He then said to Shao, "Long ago your father and I braved danger and hardship together, jointly upheld the royal house, and built this great achievement.
idiomatic: " He then said to Shao, "Long ago your father and I braved danger and hardship together, jointly upheld the royal house, and built this great achievement.

literal: Now my illness is such that I may not recover; you should well assist each other and bear up under this burden.
idiomatic: Now my illness is such that I may not recover; you should well assist each other and bear up under this burden.

literal: " He thereupon ordered Shao to follow the Founding Emperor in garrisoning Ye and summoned the Heir Apparent to the army.
idiomatic: " He thereupon ordered Shao to follow Gao Yang in garrisoning Ye and summoned Gao Cheng to the army.

literal: When the Grand Ancestor's illness grew severe, he entrusted the Heir Apparent, saying, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, upright, benevolent, and generous, combining wisdom and courage. Among kinsmen, only this man — on great military matters, you should plan together.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan's illness grew severe, he entrusted Gao Cheng, saying, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, upright, benevolent, and generous, combining wisdom and courage. Among kinsmen, only this man — on great military matters, you should plan together.

literal: " In the spring of the fifth year the Grand Ancestor died at Jinyang; the death was kept secret and mourning was not announced.
idiomatic: " In the spring of the fifth year Gao Huan died at Jinyang; the death was kept secret and mourning was not announced.

literal: Before long Hou Jing provoked rebellion; the Heir Apparent returned to Ye and Shao remained to hold Jinyang.
idiomatic: Before long Hou Jing provoked rebellion; Gao Cheng returned to Ye and Shao remained to hold Jinyang.

literal: When the Heir Apparent returned, he granted more than ten female musicians, ten jin of gold, and silk and brocade in corresponding measure, and enfeoffed Shao as Duke of Changle Commandery.
idiomatic: When Gao Cheng returned, he granted more than ten female musicians, ten jin of gold, and silk and brocade in corresponding measure, and enfeoffed Shao as duke of Changle Commandery.

literal: The Heir Apparent campaigned against Yingchuan; Shao remained to garrison Jinyang.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng campaigned against Yingchuan; Shao remained to garrison Jinyang.

literal: Separately he was enfeoffed Baron of Zhending County and acted as Governor of Bing Province.
idiomatic: Separately he was enfeoffed baron of Zhending County and acted as governor of Bing Province.

literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.
idiomatic: When Gao Yang received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.

literal: He petitioned to return the dignity of Duke of Chaoling and begged that his stepmother Lady Liang be enfeoffed as commandery lady.
idiomatic: He petitioned to return the dignity of duke of Chaoling and begged that his stepmother Lady Liang be enfeoffed as commandery lady.

literal: The Founding Emperor approved; separately Lady Liang was made Lady of Anding Commandery.
idiomatic: Gao Yang approved; separately Lady Liang was made lady of Anding Commandery.

literal: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.
idiomatic: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.

literal: Commentators praised him.
idiomatic: Commentators praised him.

literal: In the third year of Tianbao, he served as Governor of Ji Province and grand commander of six provinces; his benevolent administration won the hearts of officials and people.
idiomatic: In the third year of Tianbao, he served as governor of Ji Province and grand commander of six provinces; his benevolent administration won the hearts of officials and people.

literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the Liang general Dongfang Baie secretly reached Suyu, recruited and enticed frontier people, killed local officials, and stirred turmoil along the Huai and Si rivers.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the Liang general Dongfang Baie secretly reached Suyu, recruited and enticed frontier people, killed local officials, and stirred turmoil along the Huai and Si rivers.

literal: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.
idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.

literal: When he arrived, the Liang generals Yan Chaoda and others were pressing Jing Province;
idiomatic: When he arrived, the Liang generals Yan Chaoda and others were pressing Jing Province;

literal: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; Governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;
idiomatic: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;

literal: Yin Siling too led more than ten thousand men, plotting a surprise attack on Xuyi.
idiomatic: Yin Siling too led more than ten thousand men, plotting a surprise attack on Xuyi.

literal: The whole army was afraid.
idiomatic: The whole army was afraid.

literal: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.
idiomatic: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.

literal: Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly.
idiomatic: Chen Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly.

literal: " He left Acting Three Imperators' Jing Xianjun, Yao Nazong, and others to besiege and hold Suyu; he himself led several thousand infantry and cavalry by forced march toward Jing Province.
idiomatic: " He left acting three imperators' Jing Xianjun, Yao Nazong, and others to besiege and hold Suyu; he himself led several thousand infantry and cavalry by forced march toward Jing Province.

literal: Passing through Xuyi, Yin Siling did not expect the main army to arrive so suddenly; at sight of the banners he fled north.
idiomatic: Passing through Xuyi, Yin Siling did not expect the main army to arrive so suddenly; at sight of the banners he fled north.

literal: Advancing, he joined battle with Chaoda and routed them utterly, capturing all their boats and equipment.
idiomatic: Advancing, he joined battle with Chaoda and routed them utterly, capturing all their boats and equipment.

literal: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Baxian will surely flee.
idiomatic: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Chen Baxian will surely flee.

literal: " He at once turned back toward Guangling.
idiomatic: " He at once turned back toward Guangling.

literal: Chen Baxian indeed fled.
idiomatic: Chen Baxian indeed fled.

literal: Pursuing as far as Yangzi stockade, he sighted Yangzhou city and turned back; he captured a great store of military supplies and equipment, then wheeled his army back to Suyu.
idiomatic: Pursuing as far as Yangzi stockade, he sighted Yangzhou city and turned back; he captured a great store of military supplies and equipment, then wheeled his army back to Suyu.

literal: In the sixth month, Shao sent eloquent envoys to explain fortune and disaster to Baie; Baie thereupon opened the gates and requested an alliance.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shao sent eloquent envoys to explain fortune and disaster to Baie; Baie thereupon opened the gates and requested an alliance.

literal: Shao discussed with the mobile commissioner Xin Shu and others and provisionally accepted the alliance.
idiomatic: Shao discussed with the mobile commissioner Xin Shu and others and provisionally accepted the alliance.

literal: When the alliance was concluded, judging that Baie would never be useful, he seized and executed him, and together with his brothers sent their heads to the capital.
idiomatic: When the alliance was concluded, judging that Baie would never be useful, he seized and executed him, and together with his brothers sent their heads to the capital.

literal: The Huai and Yangzi regions grew calm; the people were all settled.
idiomatic: The Huai and Yangzi regions grew calm; the people were all settled.

literal: The Founding Emperor applauded his merit; an edict granted seventy Wu captives and enfeoffed him as Prince of Pingyuan Commandery.
idiomatic: Gao Yang applauded his merit; an edict granted seventy Wu captives and enfeoffed him as prince of Pingyuan Commandery.

literal: When Prince Qinghe Yue captured Ying Province and took Minister of Education Lu Fazhe prisoner, Shao also took part in the expedition, built tiered fortifications, established the Guo Mo garrison at Xincai, and returned.
idiomatic: When Prince Qinghe Yue captured Ying Province and took minister of education Lu Fazhe prisoner, Shao also took part in the expedition, built tiered fortifications, established the Guo Mo garrison at Xincai, and returned.

literal: In the first year of Huangjian, he served as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
idiomatic: In the first year of Huangjian, he served as grand preceptor of the crown prince.

literal: In the second year of Daining, he was appointed Governor of Bing Province.
idiomatic: In the second year of Daining, he was appointed governor of Bing Province.

literal: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, an edict ordered Shao and Prince Dong'an Lou Rui to lead troops to suppress and pacify him; Shao was transferred to Grand Preceptor, granted ten female musicians, and also given Guiyan's orchard of a thousand mu.
idiomatic: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, an edict ordered Shao and Prince Dong'an Lou Rui to lead troops to suppress and pacify him; Shao was transferred to grand preceptor, granted ten female musicians, and also given Guiyan's orchard of a thousand mu.

literal: He still went to Bing Province; in governing he upheld broad principles and did not dwell on petty scrutiny, winning great harmony among the people.
idiomatic: He still went to Bing Province; in governing he upheld broad principles and did not dwell on petty scrutiny, winning great harmony among the people.

literal: In the twelfth month, the Zhou Emperor Wu dispatched generals leading Qiang and tribal forces together with the Turks in a combined host pressing Jinyang; the Shizu Emperor hurried from Ye by forced march to the rescue.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou dispatched generals leading Qiang and tribal forces together with the Turks in a combined host pressing Jinyang; Gao Yan hurried from Ye by forced march to the rescue.

literal: The Turks advanced from the north in battle formation, touching the Fen River on the east and Wind Valley on the west.
idiomatic: The Turks advanced from the north in battle formation, touching the Fen River on the east and Wind Valley on the west.
